prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps has been helpful overall (+3.0% average after noise correction), though one test showed no clear effect.
Home redesign changes have shown no clear effect across 2 tests (-2.9% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for finish and new_screen changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for sign_in redesign changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Predictions have consistently been too high compared to measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- finish, new_screen: -5.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -2.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Grid view path selection redesign: Redesign the choose path screen with a structured grid layout displaying preset companion path vs custom pet generation path clearly. (why: The choose_path stage has a high mean duration of 514 seconds and 76.2% conversion, showing users hesitate when picking their onboarding path.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after adoption certificate completion: Shift the sign-in step to immediately follow the adoption certificate stage, securing user pet metadata right after creation. (why: Support receives 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and moving sign-in after adoption helps explicitly connect the newly created pet to the user account.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop pet placement guide screen: Insert a new desktop placement screen before home intro showing users where their pet resides on screen and how to access menu options. (why: Finish step drop-off is notable (64.8% conversion, 395s median) and support received multiple complaints about pets not showing up or users not knowing how to control/hide them.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Sample photo template pick_friend flow: Update the photo upload screen to include template choice cards for users without personal photos ready. (why: Adoption stage has the lowest step conversion (60.9%) and 1017s mean time, while support noted 3 issues with custom pet generation failing.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop background generation progress indicator: Enable progress bar, time estimate, and ready notifications on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The waiting screen has an extreme mean duration of 2336s, suggesting users leave the app idle without knowing generation status.)
5: [finish, layout] Spotlight layout for home welcome intro: Convert home_intro to a spotlight layout focusing on the main CTA to launch the pet onto the desktop. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% with long median time (395s), indicating users stall at the final step before launch.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Onboarding duration expectation hint on story screen: Add a hint banner to the story screen informing users that setup takes under 2 minutes. (why: Mean time spent on initial choose_path step is 514s, indicating initial user hesitation right at launch.)
7: [home, notification] Background pet generation completion alert: Configure ready notifications on the waiting screen so users get a system toast when rendering completes in the background. (why: Waiting step mean duration is 2336s because users minimize the app while waiting for heavy asset creation.)

scores.note: Redesigns have historically shown poor or negative results; choose_path has long mean duration but lacks support email complaints.
Sign-in reordering has a proven +3.0% lift in previous tests, and support tickets strongly confirm post-sign-in pet loss issues.
High funnel drop-off and support tickets exist, but adding new screens at finish previously yielded -5.8% conversion.
Targeting the lowest conversion step (60.9%) backed by both funnel drop-off and support tickets regarding failed pet generation.
Addresses the extreme 2336s wait time during generation, though overall step conversion is already high (81.3%).
Finish step loses over 35% of users, but evidence relies primarily on funnel metrics without direct support email backing.
Cheap configuration hint to set time expectations and reduce early hesitation on choose_path.
Low cost notification toggle addressing extreme mean waiting time (2336s) when users minimize during background rendering.
